_what: S22's configuration as data: what is the retailer's own and so cannot be a default in the manifest (the company, the currency, the walk-in customers, Member cash's payment method), and the receipt check a customer may add. The tiers, their plans, the programme's default settings and the app role's rights are in manifest.json (records and role_rights), made by the install. apply_config.py reads this file (or PP_CONFIG). The names and amounts are the sandbox template's (Demo Retail, USD); change them to the shop's. Every name starts with PP LYL so remove finds what it made.
